# Dialog

A dialog is a layer above all content, requesting information or an additional action.
See [Modal guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/modal/design/)

The `ds-dialog` class simply gives a container the look of a dialog.

Inside the dialog, you may use different classes to style its content:

- `ds-dialog-header` for the dialog title,
- `ds-dialog-content` to wrap the main content and give it some padding,
- `ds-dialog-actions` for the card actions.

<Canvas of={DialogStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={DialogStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```
